## Design

### 2026-11-01: I think tech should always be cute and fun so this is my take of a hairclip with a display. The case is a two-part print that fits the T-Display and a 602540 battery: a shell that holds the board, and

**6h**

I think tech should always be cute and fun so this is my take of a hairclip with a display. The case is a two-part print that fits the T-Display and a 602540 battery: a shell that holds the board, and a back lid where the clip gets glued on. It’s parametric, so I can change the dimensions once I measure my parts. The firmware makes the clip its own Wi-Fi network.
